meta.prompt: Show six running shoes as a carousel I can swipe or step through with arrows, with dots and a position like "3 of 6": Aero Runner $120, 4.8 stars; Trail Scout $135, 4.6; Tempo Flash $150, 4.7; Cloud Stride $140, 4.5; Daybreak 2 $95, 4.4; Night Owl $125, 4.6, each with a picture placeholder. Tapping one opens its details in place: its name and price, a description (for Tempo Flash: "A snappy plate and a low stack for intervals and race day."), sizes 7 to 12 to pick (8 is sold out), the chosen size shown as "Size 9" and so on, an Add to bag button, and a way back to the carousel.
meta.text:
state shoes=[{"id":"aero","name":"Aero Runner","price":120,"rating":4.8,"kind":"shoe","tone":"sand","detail":"Light daily trainer"},{"id":"trail","name":"Trail Scout","price":135,"rating":4.6,"kind":"shoe","tone":"mint","detail":"Grip for rough ground"},{"id":"tempo","name":"Tempo Flash","price":150,"rating":4.7,"kind":"shoe","tone":"sky","detail":"A snappy plate and a low stack for intervals and race day."},{"id":"cloud","name":"Cloud Stride","price":140,"rating":4.5,"kind":"shoe","tone":"lilac","detail":"Soft cushioning for long miles"},{"id":"day","name":"Daybreak 2","price":95,"rating":4.4,"kind":"shoe","tone":"rose","detail":"An easy everyday shoe"},{"id":"owl","name":"Night Owl","price":125,"rating":4.6,"kind":"shoe","tone":"slate","detail":"Reflective details for evening runs"}]
state i=0
state open=false
state size=""
Card w:390 gap:12
  if !open
    Text.heading "Running shoes"
    Carousel =i items:=shoes -> open=true
    PageDots =i count:=length(shoes)
    Text.muted "{i+1} of {length(shoes)}"
  if open
    Row between
      Button.ghost "Back to shoes" -> open=false; size=""
      Text.muted "{i+1} of {length(shoes)}"
    Media kind:"shoe" tone:=shoes[i].tone h:160
    Text.title "{shoes[i].name}"
    Text.strong "{money(shoes[i].price,"$",0)}"
    Paragraph "{shoes[i].detail}"
    if shoes[i].id=="tempo"
      Paragraph "A snappy plate and a low stack for intervals and race day."
    SectionLabel "Size" "pick one"
    ChoiceChips =size options:["7","8","9","10","11","12"] disabled:["8"] columns:3
    if size!=""
      Text.muted "Size {size}"
    ActionButton "Add to bag" primary icon:"shopping_bag" enabled:{size!=""} -> emit addToBag; toast "Added to bag"
